note: One entry per simulation or game. id = folder name under sims/ and the web address statswithtech.org/sims/<id>. Run kit sims/sims.py build after editing.

sims.title: Dice Rolling Simulation
sims.blurb: Roll one or two dice many times and watch the empirical probabilities settle near the theoretical ones (the Law of Large Numbers).

sims.title: Coin Flip Simulation
sims.blurb: Flip a coin over larger and larger numbers of trials and watch the empirical probability of heads settle near 0.5 (Table 2 and Figure 5.8).

sims.title: Roulette Game Simulator
sims.blurb: Make the straight up, Red or first dozen $10 bets from Example 12, spin the wheel, and compare your total winnings with the expected value of −$0.5263 per bet.

sims.title: Distribution Shape Game
sims.blurb: Identify each histogram as bell-shaped (normal), uniform, skewed left or skewed right. Get 10 in a row to become a master of distribution shapes.

sims.title: Sensitivity of the Mean and Median Game
sims.blurb: Watch one of five data values move and predict whether the mean and the median will increase, decrease or stay the same. Get 5 in a row to win.

sims.title: Finding Percentiles and Quartiles Game
sims.blurb: Drag a line across a dot plot of 100 values to find percentiles and quartiles, from the 3rd percentile to the 99th. Get 5 in a row to win.

sims.title: Best Measures for the Data Game
sims.blurb: Look at a bell-shaped or skewed histogram and choose the best measure of center (mean or median) and of variation (standard deviation or IQR). Get 5 in a row to win.

sims.title: Choose the Best Graph Game
sims.blurb: Match three short scenarios with the graph that best displays each one’s data: bar graph, pie chart, Pareto chart, split bar graph, histogram, dot plot, stem-and-leaf plot, boxplot or time-series plot. Win 3 rounds in a row.

sims.title: “To Reject or Not Reject” – The Hypothesis Test Conclusion Game
sims.blurb: Read a claim, decide whether the test is left-tailed, right-tailed or two-tailed, then choose the conclusion that matches the decision to reject or fail to reject H0. Get 5 in a row to win.

sims.title: The P-Value Decision Game
sims.blurb: Read a claim and its hypotheses, collect the data and get the P-value, then choose the correct decision and conclusion at the 0.05 or 0.01 significance level. Win 3 rounds in a row.

sims.title: Central Limit Theorem Simulation
sims.blurb: Choose a parent distribution and sample size, take samples, and watch each sample mean drop into the distribution of sample means as it builds a bell shape. Add samples 5, 10 or 100 at a time and show the normal curve.

sims.title: Confidence Interval Simulation
sims.blurb: Take random samples from a normal population and build confidence intervals one, 10 or 100 at a time. Green intervals contain the population mean and red ones miss it; the tally shows what percent capture μ.

sims.title: Correlation Whisperer Game
sims.blurb: Look at a random scatterplot, with faint lines at the means of x and y, and guess the correlation r. Get within 0.15 (0.2 near 0) to win the round; win 5 rounds in a row to become a Correlation Whisperer.

sims.title: Investigate the Margin of Error
sims.blurb: Slide the sample size n from 1 to 100 and the confidence level from 70% to 99% and watch a confidence interval for a mean (x̄ = 50, s = 10) shrink or grow on a fixed scale.
